Class StoreFront

java.lang.Object
app.StoreFront
public class StoreFront extends Object
Runs the console-based Arena Supply Store for the game user. Coordinates purchases and cancellations between inventory and the cart.

    • purchaseProduct

      public boolean purchaseProduct(int index)
      Purchases one unit of a product and adds it to the cart if in stock. In the unlikely case that cart insertion fails, the stock is restored.
      Parameters:
      index - zero-based product position
      Returns:
      true when the item is successfully moved to the cart

    • cancelPurchase

      public boolean cancelPurchase(int index)
      Cancels a selected purchase and returns one unit to store inventory. In the unlikely case that restocking fails, the cart is restored.
      Parameters:
      index - zero-based product position
      Returns:
      true when an item in the cart has been returned to stock

    • emptyShoppingCart

      public boolean emptyShoppingCart()
      Empties the shopping cart and returns all selected products to the store inventory.
      Returns:
      true if every cart item was successfully returned
